title: Doodle Boil
summary: A hand-drawn outline boils around the speaker while doodles draw themselves on.
description: The footage plays untouched while a white chalk outline traces the speaker's silhouette, redrawn every few frames so it 'boils' like hand-drawn animation. Doodles (heart, clapperboard, frames, stars, arrows...) draw themselves on next to the head, get a pink or yellow scribble fill, and boil too. In auto mode a new doodle lands on each emphasised word, and a newer doodle in the same spot replaces the older one.

options.doodles: "auto" (a sequence timed to the emphasised words) or a list of doodles: {"type", "slot" or "x"/"y", "at", "until", "size", "color", "fill", "accent", "rotate"}
options.doodles[].type: heart, clapper, frame, square, star, arrow, sparkle, crown, swirl or circle
options.doodles[].slot: where it sits relative to the head: left, right, topLeft, topRight, aboveHead (a newer doodle in the same slot replaces the older one)
options.doodles[].x / y: instead of a slot: centre position as 0-1 fractions of the frame
options.doodles[].until: optional: when it disappears (otherwise it stays, or until replaced in its slot)
options.doodles[].size: width as a fraction of the frame width (default 0.15-0.2)
options.doodles[].fill: scribble fill colour, or null for no fill
options.doodles[].accent: colour of the spark lines / clapper stripes
options.minGap: auto mode: minimum seconds between doodles
options.drawFrames: frames each doodle takes to draw on
options.fillDelay: frames between the outline finishing and the scribble fill starting
options.boilEvery: redraw the wobble every N frames (2 = fast boil, 4 = slow)
options.chalk: chalky, speckled line texture (false = clean lines)
options.shadow: opacity of the soft dark shadow under the lines (helps on bright walls)
options.outline.enabled: draw the outline around the speaker
options.outline.offset: gap between the body and the line in px
options.outline.wobble: how much the line wanders in px
options.outline.double: add a thinner second pass for a sketchy double stroke
options.outline.drawOn: trace the outline on at the start
